chapter: Jazz at parties and social acceptance
title: Jazz at teenage parties, ages 14 to 17
summary: Among her friends jazz was the only music for parties, and they went to the French Quarter to hear it.

blocks.x: What would you say your friends would think of it?
I think most of my friends...
Oh, I thought of it then I should say.
Well, thought of it then. That was back around when I was...
When you first started going out to parties.

When we first started going out to parties it was just about the only form of music as far as my friends were concerned. That it was the only kind of band that we would consider getting for a good time and it was the only kind of music that we would go all the way down to the French Quarter to listen to.
Would you say most of the parties you went to then... About what age was this when we started going out?
From between 14 to 17 high school years.
Would you say most of the parties then tended to have jazz bands?
